summary_en: BCJ-116's amended tender offer for Hokuriku Electric's shares incorporates Hokuriku Bank's commitment to tender all its holdings, and notification of the Fair Trade Commission's clearance issued on November 16, 2026, with no exclusionary order and shortened prohibition period.
title_en: Notice of Amendment to "Notice Regarding Commencement of Tender Offer for Ordinary Shares of Hokuriku Electric Industry Co., Ltd. (Securities Code: 6989) by BCJ-116 Co., Ltd." and Public Notice of Tender Offer Commencement
translation_en_brief:
BCJ-116 Co., Ltd. submitted an amended tender offer filing on November 19, 2026, regarding its tender offer for ordinary shares of Hokuriku Electric Industry Co., Ltd., which commenced on November 11, 2026. The amendment incorporates two key developments: first, on November 17, 2026, Hokuriku Bank agreed in writing to tender all of its shares in Hokuriku Electric and not to withdraw such tender; second, the Fair Trade Commission notified BCJ-116 on November 17, 2026 of two decisions issued on November 16, 2026—that no exclusionary order would be issued, and that the prohibition period would be shortened.

Among previously announced subscribers, FCT Co., Ltd. held 1,048,800 shares (13.36% ownership), Hokuriku Bank held 158,365 shares (2.02%), Maeda Corporation held 149,000 shares (1.90%), and Toyama Bank held 139,800 shares (1.78%), collectively committing 1,495,965 shares (19.06% ownership) to the tender offer. The November 17 agreement with Hokuriku Bank represents a material addition to the subscriber base, strengthening BCJ-116's acquisition prospects. The FTC clearances remove regulatory uncertainty and reduce the standstill obligations period, allowing the tender offer to proceed as scheduled. The filing clarifies that these amendments do not constitute changes to tender offer conditions under the Financial Instruments and Exchange Act.
